questions.answer: It was a chaos of misunderstandings in the agreement between the two institutions. At one time my spot at the university was canceled. In the end everything figured itself out.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *

questions.answer: Went perfect. I got exactly the courses I wanted and KU accepted every course.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Do not take challenges in the registration process as serious.
